chapter: Brass bands, Eddie Miller and band stories
title: Eddie Edwards and the Original Dixieland Jazz Band
summary: A letter from Eddie Edwards leads to memories of knowing Edwards and drummer Sbarbaro, seen in Miami advertised with the ODJB.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I got a letter from Eddie Edwards the other day.
Is that a fact? He played with the original Dixieland Jazz Band. Yes, sir.
I'm sure you knew him, Daddy.
Oh, yes, I did. I knew Eddie. I don't know whether they remember me. I remember Swoboda, too. No, was it Shabarra or Swoboda? The drummer? The drummer.

Sparbarro, yeah, that was it. Yeah. I saw him down in Miami some, well, it was quite a number of years ago now. He had an orchestra down there playing drums and had him advertised as a drummer with the original Dixieland Jazz Band, big sign out.
